events.verdict: Carter (ATL) establishes and maintains legal position during the pick with Sexton (CLE).
Young (ATL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Carter (ATL) briefly clasp Sexton's (CLE) arm while disengaging from the pick.
Burks (CLE) engages with Huerter (ATL) while setting the pick.
Huerter (ATL) makes contact with Nance's Jr. (CLE) body but does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
Carter (ATL) is firming up in legal position during the pick with Sexton (CLE).
Bembry (ATL) makes contact with Osman's (CLE) head and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Burks (CLE) makes incidental contact with Carter's (ATL) head during the rebound but does not affect his ability to get to the ball.
Clarkson (CLE) makes marginal contact with Young (ATL) while disengaging from the pick.
Nance Jr. (CLE) cleanly dislodges the ball then makes incidental contact with Collins' (ATL) wrist during the rebound.
Although Nance Jr. (CLE) makes some contact with Young (ATL) while disengaging from the pick the reaction from Young (ATL) is not consistent with the contact from Nance Jr. (CLE).
Nance Jr. (CLE) jumps A to B and makes contact with Huerter's (ATL) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Sexton (CLE) makes contact with Collins' (ATL) arm during the follow-through on his shot near the rim but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
LLB shows - Osman (CLE) makes contact with Collins' (ATL) shoulder during his shot at the rim although Collins (ATL) moves through the contact and finishes at the rim.
LAR shows- Young (ATL) makes contact with Sexton's (CLE) arm during his drive and affects his ability to gather.
Anderson (ATL) cleanly steals the pass intended for Nance Jr. (CLE) without affecting his FOM.
Huerter (ATL) engages with Sexton (CLE) during the rebound but does not affect his ability to get to the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Huerter (ATL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
[Observable in enhanced video] Young (ATL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Burks (CLE) makes contact to Bembry (ATL) during rebounding affecting his ability to get to the ball.
Collins (ATL) makes incidental contact to Osman's (CLE) face as he gathers the ball during the rebound.
Huerter (ATL) makes high-five contact with Clarkson's (CLE) hand after he has released the ball.
Osman (CLE) commits a take foul on Carter (ATL).
Collins (ATL) briefly places an arm around Sexton (CLE) during the inbound.
